content.short: Hyperstitions turns prediction markets into coordination markets where backers help outcomes happen.
content.description: Hyperstitions builds what it calls coordination markets, where a prediction market is attached to a goal that participants can act to bring about. A protocol creates a market, participants buy the token, bet YES and then do the work, and everyone holding a position profits if the goal is reached. The project claims more than nine million dollars in cumulative volume and runs on an EVM-compatible network.
content.meta: Prediction markets reworked so the people betting on an outcome help bring it about.
